scope: Targeted primary-source research for a 2D exemplar-conditioned detector trained only on our procedural scenes. Published natural-data scores are not comparable to the planned synthetic experiment.

sources.title: Fully-Convolutional Siamese Networks for Object Tracking
sources.authors: Luca Bertinetto, Jack Valmadre, Joao F. Henriques, Andrea Vedaldi, Philip H. S. Torr
sources.mechanism: Shared convolutional embeddings; exemplar/search cross-correlation produces a dense response map, trained with logistic loss.
sources.budget: Gaussian random initialization; ILSVRC15 video pairs; 50 epochs of 50,000 pairs, batch8. One inference exemplar follows substantial offline natural-video training.
sources.adoption: Architectural antecedent for exemplar-conditioned spatial matching; no published weights or natural training data imported.
sources.limit: Tracking uses temporal search context and exact object appearance; it is not a one-image-total category learner.

sources.title: One-Shot Object Detection with Co-Attention and Co-Excitation
sources.authors: Ting-I Hsieh, Yi-Chen Lo, Hwann-Tzong Chen, Tyng-Luh Liu
sources.mechanism: Query-conditioned proposals, channel co-excitation and margin-based proposal ranking.
sources.budget: Reduced ResNet50 pretraining uses933,052 ImageNet images from725 classes; detector training uses VOC/COCO,10epochs,batch128. COCO support filtering also uses pretrained MaskRCNN.
sources.adoption: Separate proposal quality from reference-match quality; matched hard-negative ranking is an established idea.
sources.limit: Paper scores average five sampled support trials and require large prior data budgets; they are not our exact one-reference synthetic metric.

sources.title: Dense Contrastive Learning for Self-Supervised Visual Pre-Training
sources.authors: Xinlong Wang, Rufeng Zhang, Chunhua Shen, Tao Kong, Lei Li
sources.mechanism: Local correspondence contrast complements a global contrastive objective.
sources.budget: COCO roughly118k natural images for800epochs or ImageNet roughly1.28M for200epochs, followed by supervised downstream fine-tuning.
sources.adoption: Potential local-feature consistency objective using our known2D transforms instead of inferred correspondence.
sources.limit: Local visual correspondence does not by itself define semantic category equivalence or resolve unobservable micro-patterns.

sources.title: SuperPoint: Self-Supervised Interest Point Detection and Description
sources.authors: Daniel DeTone, Tomasz Malisiewicz, Andrew Rabinovich
sources.mechanism: Synthetic corner supervision followed by homographic adaptation and joint interest-point/descriptor learning.
sources.budget: MagicPoint synthetic stage200,000 iterations; paper statesbatch32. Final SuperPoint uses80,000 COCO2014 training photographs and100 homographies for pseudo-labeling, repeated twice.
sources.adoption: Known procedural transforms can supply correspondence without an external learned teacher.
sources.limit: The full published model is not synthetic-only; a homography models a planar warp, not arbitrary category variation.

sources.title: Making Convolutional Networks Shift-Invariant Again
sources.mechanism: Low-pass filtering directly before subsampling reduces aliasing in strided CNNs.
sources.budget: Natural-image classification and image-translation experiments; no one-exemplar synthetic-only detection claim.
sources.adoption: Motivates explicit stride/visibility diagnostics and preserving a high-resolution matching path.
sources.limit: Antialiasing removes unsupported frequencies; it cannot preserve every tiny pattern after aggressive downsampling. No automatic blur module is implied by this review.

sources.title: CLEVR: A Diagnostic Dataset for Compositional Language and Elementary Visual Reasoning
sources.authors: Justin Johnson, Bharath Hariharan, Laurens van der Maaten, Li Fei-Fei, C. Lawrence Zitnick, Ross Girshick
sources.mechanism: CoGenT holds out attribute combinations, rather than merely new random examples with familiar combinations.
sources.budget: CoGenT conditionA has70,000 training scenes and699,960 questions; distinct evaluation conditions swap color/shape combinations.
sources.adoption: Split whole2D grammar compositions and audit overlap of factor combinations.
sources.limit: We borrow a split-design principle only, not its3D renderer, VQA task or published scores. Thousands of procedural combinations are not thousands of semantic natural categories.

proposed_loss: L=L_objectness+L_box+L_family_match+lambda_b*BCE(s,y)+lambda_m*max(0,margin+s_micro_negative−s_positive). Keep object proposals/data/initialization fixed across the family-only and micro-aware arms.
visibility_note: A2px feature is near a sampling limit, not guaranteed recognizable identity. Audit the actual projected support/query widths, occlusion and changed pixels; report failures rather than silently removing hard TEST cases.
originality: Siamese matching, proposal ranking and local contrastive learning are established. The candidate contribution is the constrained procedural curriculum, counterbalanced microidentity task and reproducible data-budget evaluation; firstness and natural-category transfer remain unproved.
